full_judgment:
M. Enayetur Rahim, J: This Rule was issued calling upon the opposite parties to show cause as to why the order dated 26.10.2017 passed by the learned Metropolitan Senior Special and Sessions Judge (hereinafter referred to as the learned Judge), Dhaka in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.7703 of 2017 arising out of Tejgaon Police Station Case No.05 dated. 04.08.2017 under sections 409/ 467/ 648/ 471/ 420/ 109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 now pending in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka enlarging the accused opposite party on bail should not be set aside and/or pass such other or further order or orders as this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 19. The order dated 26.10.2017 passed by the learned Metropolitan Senior Special and Sessions Judge, Dhaka in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.7702 of 2017 arising out of Tejgaon Police Station Case No.06 dated 04.08.2017 under sections 409/ 467/ 648/ 471/ 420/ 109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 is hereby set aside.
